bioconda.name: tussl-chemistry
bioconda.summary: Names a single-cell RNA library's chemistry from its first reads, across vendors.
bioconda.description:
tchem reads the first reads of a single-cell RNA library and names its kit, read geometry,
barcode lists, cDNA strand and library type, with a confidence, across vendors (10x, BD
Rhapsody, Parse, SPLiT-seq, Singleron, ScaleBio, MGI and others). tchem-fetch-whitelists
downloads the vendors' barcode lists and checks each against its registered sha256; the
lists belong to their vendors and are not part of this package.
